issues.title: Missing GWT for Go Binary Archetype
issues.why: While the Browser Extension sub-module has a dedicated AC file (97-acceptance-criteria.md), the Go Binary sub-module (02-go-binary-deploy) lacks any testable acceptance criteria despite being a primary archetype.
issues.fix: Create spec/12-cicd-pipeline-workflows/02-go-binary-deploy/97-acceptance-criteria.md with GWT cases for cross-compilation targets and checksum verification.

issues.title: Undefined 'sdk-name' and 'module-name' placeholders
issues.why: The Browser Extension CI pipeline (01-ci-pipeline.md) uses placeholders like <sdk-name> and <module-name> in artifact paths without defining where these values are sourced from (e.g., package.json name field or a specific config file).
issues.fix: Explicitly state that <sdk-name> and <module-name> must match the 'name' field in the respective component's package.json.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'version' resolution in CI vs Release
issues.why: CI pipelines use 'dev-<sha>' while Release pipelines use semantic versions, but the shared version resolution logic in 01-shared-conventions.md doesn't explicitly show the 'dev-' string concatenation logic for the CI branch case.
issues.fix: Update the version resolution bash snippet to include the 'dev-${GITHUB_SHA::10}' assignment for non-tag/non-release branches.
